stories.title: Theatr Clwyd to mark 50th anniversary with star-studded fundraising night
stories.summary: Alex Hassell, Sian Gibson, Rakie Ayola and Kimberly Hart-Simpson will take to the stage at Theatr Clwyd on 20 September. The Mold theatre is marking 50 years with a one-off fundraising show called Made Right Here: Theatr Clwyd at 50. Every penny from ticket sales goes towards the theatre’s work on and off the stage.

stories.title: Record-breaking summer school helps young people take their next step
stories.summary: A record-breaking summer programme has given young people the confidence and skills to take their next steps at Coleg Cambria. stories.title: £10,600 raised at Caerwys classic car show for air ambulance and hospice
stories.summary: A classic car show in Caerwys has raised £10,600 for Wales Air Ambulance and St Kentigern Hospice. The two charities each received £5,300 from this year’s event.
